title: Paper Claim Member Cost Share and Pharmacy Benefit Plan Accumulators (Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit)
content:
**Configuration rule.** The member cost share of a paper claim under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit depends on the member's accumulators and the drug, read from the member's active Pharmacy Benefit Plan enrollment:

1. When the out-of-pocket met on the member's active plan enrollment has reached the plan's individual out-of-pocket maximum, the member cost share is zero.
2. When that maximum has not been reached and the drug is an insulin product (Lantus or insulin glargine-yfgn), the member cost share is its deductible portion plus the lesser of the plan's insulin cap per 30 days multiplied by the day-supply multiple, rounded to the cent, and its tier cost share.
3. Otherwise it is its deductible portion plus its tier cost share.

"Reached" means the out-of-pocket met is equal to or more than the individual out-of-pocket maximum.

## Decision table

| Out-of-pocket met has reached the individual maximum | Drug is Lantus or insulin glargine-yfgn | Member cost share |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes or no | Zero |
| No | Yes | Deductible portion plus the lesser of the insulin cap per 30 days multiplied by the day-supply multiple (rounded to the cent) and the tier cost share |
| No | No | Deductible portion plus tier cost share |

## Configured examples (hypothetical plan figures)

- Individual out-of-pocket maximum 3,000.00 USD, out-of-pocket met 3,000.00 USD: the member cost share is zero, for an insulin product or any other drug.
- Out-of-pocket met 2,999.99 USD of the same maximum, Lantus, 30 reimbursed days (multiple of one), insulin cap 35.00 USD per 30 days, tier cost share 60.00 USD, deductible portion zero: the lesser of 35.00 USD and 60.00 USD is 35.00 USD.
- Same as above but a 45-day receipt on a network whose 35-60 day multiple is 2.0, with a tier cost share of 60.00 USD: the cap is 35.00 USD multiplied by 2.0, that is 70.00 USD, and the lesser of 70.00 USD and 60.00 USD is 60.00 USD.
- A drug that is not an insulin product, deductible portion 15.00 USD and tier cost share 25.00 USD, maximum not reached: 40.00 USD.
